newsitem.title: UK: Dlr firms across board, sets 11-week high vs yen.
newsitem.headline: Dlr firms across board, sets 11-week high vs yen.

text.p: The dollar was flexing its muscles and setting its sights on higher ground by midsession on Wednesday, as it probed 1.84 marks and set 11-week highs against the yen.

Dollar/yen rose as high as 118.83, bolstered by weak Japanese industrial output figures for June. But with traders willing to snap up dollars across the board, the U.S. currency could this week reach 120 yen -- a level many consider to be the limit of official tolerance.
"I can see it making a crack at 120," said Nick Probert, head of spot trading at Bank of America in London.
